taxonomy.title: Specialty / taxonomy
taxonomy.description: Taxonomy description as used by NPPES, e.g. "Dentist", "Family Medicine", "Physical Therapist", "Pharmacy".

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter US state codes, e.g. RI, CA. Each state is exported in full.

enumerationType.title: Provider type
enumerationType.description: Restrict to individual providers (NPI-1), organizations (NPI-2), or both.

postalCode.title: ZIP code
postalCode.description: Optional. 5-digit ZIP, or a prefix with a trailing wildcard such as 902*.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: Optional. Trailing wildcard allowed after 2 characters, e.g. jo*.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Optional. Trailing wildcard allowed after 2 characters.

organizationName.title: Organization name
organizationName.description: Optional. Trailing wildcard allowed after 2 characters.

npiNumbers.title: NPI numbers (bulk lookup)
npiNumbers.description: If given, the actor looks up these 10-digit NPIs and ignores the search filters.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many providers. Leave empty for all.

includeRaw.title: Include raw API record
includeRaw.description: Add the full original NPPES JSON (all addresses, taxonomies, identifiers) to each row.
